title: KKE Farm
description: You are a dog on a farm. Sheep graze and bolt as a flock when you run at them, cows come to have a look, pigs root in their pen, horses spook and a fox keeps its distance: every animal runs on the AI core (senses, needs, utility decisions, navmesh). Needs POLYGON Farm, POLYGON Dogs and Quaternius' Farm Animals in assets/synty/ (never committed).
